elements_selected.content: Extract the public surface of CrdtDocument (new, from_markdown, text, marks, splice_text, mark, unmark, to_markdown, save, load, fork, merge) into a CrdtBackend trait in src/crdt/backend.rs. Make the existing automerge-based CrdtDocument implement it. Update src/web/ws.rs to take `&dyn CrdtBackend` (or `Box<dyn CrdtBackend>`) instead of the concrete type. No behavior change. Trait MUST be designed so the diamond-types impl can satisfy it without a marks::Mark<'_> return type leaking automerge — return a project-owned Mark struct in src/crdt/marks.rs.
